firm_data.firm_description: Pheterson Spatorico LLP is a Rochester-based law firm dedicated to providing high-quality legal services with a focus on experience, efficiency, and results. With over a century of combined legal experience, our attorneys and staff are committed to delivering strategic, cost-effective solutions tailored to each client’s unique goals.
notable_facts: The firm has been providing legal services to the citizens of New York State for more than 40 years.
The firm has over 100 years of combined legal experience.

email.subject: AI for Pheterson Spatorico LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Derrick,

With over 40 years serving New York State clients across real estate, civil litigation, and personal injury work, Pheterson Spatorico has built something most firms struggle to maintain: deep expertise paired with operational efficiency. That combination is exactly what we see firms need right now.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in Rochester to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
